fact: Where is Johnson & Johnson headquartered? New Brunswick, New Jersey
quote: Johnson & Johnson is headquartered in New Brunswick, New Jersey.

fact: Who became Johnson & Johnson's CEO in January 2022? Joaquin Duato
quote: Joaquin Duato became CEO in January 2022 and Chairman in January 2023.

fact: What did Johnson & Johnson rename its Janssen pharmaceutical business in 2023? Johnson & Johnson Innovative Medicine
quote: In September 2023 J&J renamed its pharmaceutical business, Janssen, as Johnson & Johnson Innovative Medicine; the device business is Johnson & Johnson MedTech.

fact: Under which name did Johnson & Johnson separate its consumer health business in 2023? Kenvue
quote: The renaming followed the 2023 separation of the consumer health business as Kenvue.

fact: Which Cambridge biotech did Johnson & Johnson acquire in 2020? Momenta Pharmaceuticals
quote: Momenta Pharmaceuticals, a Cambridge company: J&J completed its acquisition on 1 October 2020, for about $6.5B.

fact: Which antibody did Johnson & Johnson gain full global rights to by acquiring Momenta? Nipocalimab
quote: It gave J&J full global rights to nipocalimab.

fact: For which disease did the FDA approve Johnson & Johnson's Imaavy in 2025? Generalised myasthenia gravis
quote: Nipocalimab, branded Imaavy, was approved by the FDA in April 2025 for generalised myasthenia gravis.

fact: Under which brand name did the FDA approve Johnson & Johnson's nipocalimab? Imaavy
quote: Nipocalimab, branded Imaavy, was approved by the FDA in April 2025 for generalised myasthenia gravis.

fact: Where is Abiomed, acquired by Johnson & Johnson in 2022, based? Danvers, Massachusetts
quote: Abiomed, of Danvers, Massachusetts: J&J completed its acquisition on 22 December 2022, at an enterprise value of about $16.6B.

fact: What does Abiomed, now part of Johnson & Johnson MedTech, make? Impella heart pumps
quote: Abiomed makes Impella heart pumps and runs as a standalone business within J&J MedTech.

fact: In which Kendall Square facility does Johnson & Johnson Innovation run JLABS? LabCentral
quote: In Cambridge, Johnson & Johnson Innovation runs JLABS @ LabCentral in Kendall Square, the first East Coast JLABS site.

fact: Who became head of Johnson & Johnson Innovative Medicine on 1 September 2026? Tom Cavanaugh
quote: Tom Cavanaugh became head of Innovative Medicine on 1 September 2026, succeeding Jennifer Taubert.
Q2 2026 Innovative Medicine sales were $16.4B, up 6.8% operationally, against an approximately 760 basis point headwind from STELARA losing exclusivity.
Full-year 2026 guidance was raised to $11.60-$11.75 adjusted EPS on $100.8-$101.4B of revenue, with Innovative Medicine leading growth.

fact: Icotrokinra (Icotyde) filed for plaque psoriasis; approval pending
quote: Regulatory applications were filed for icotrokinra, branded Icotyde, in moderate-to-severe plaque psoriasis, with approval considered likely during 2026.
